PROJECT: E-Commerce Checkout Revamp
EXPORT DATE: 2026-03-01
EXPORTED FROM: Jira (CHKT project)

-----------------------------------------------------------------
CHKT-101: Guest checkout with saved shipping address
-----------------------------------------------------------------
Type: Story
Status: Ready for QA

As a returning guest shopper, I want to check out using a shipping
address I entered on a previous order, so that I don't have to
retype it every time.

Acceptance Criteria:
- On the checkout page, a "Use previous address" checkbox appears
  if a saved address exists for the guest's email.
- Checking it fills the address fields and disables manual editing.
- The order confirmation page shows the used address and an order
  number.

-----------------------------------------------------------------
CHKT-104: Apply a promo code at checkout
-----------------------------------------------------------------
Type: Story
Status: Ready for QA

As a shopper, I want to enter a promo code on the checkout page, so
that my order total reflects any discount I'm entitled to.

Acceptance Criteria:
- A "Promo code" field and "Apply" button are visible on checkout.
- Entering a valid code and clicking Apply updates the displayed
  total and shows a "Promo applied" confirmation message.
- Entering an invalid code shows an inline error and does not
  change the total.

-----------------------------------------------------------------
CHKT-107: Checkout blocked when cart has an out-of-stock item
-----------------------------------------------------------------
Type: Story
Status: Ready for QA

As a shopper, I want to be warned before paying if something in my
cart just went out of stock, so that I'm not charged for something
that won't ship.

Acceptance Criteria:
- If any cart item is out of stock at the time "Place Order" is
  clicked, checkout does not proceed to payment.
- An inline warning banner lists the affected item(s) by name.
- The shopper can remove the affected item and retry checkout.
